name: Mew Myaf
source:
Bit's relentless self-proclaimed rival, who appears as a cat-eared avatar and drives a monstrous machine.

She spares no expense when it comes to purchasable items, always trying to buy her way to victory, but her execution always falls short.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983260/LUNARiA_Virtualized_Moonchild/]Steam[/url]]

[spoiler]She's the daughter of the CEO of Selene. Her real name is Illya Rozhdestvenskaya (イリヤ・ロジェストヴェンスカヤ)[/spoiler]
